svg.title: Electric and magnetic fields around a microstrip trace
svg.desc: Cross-section of a 3 mm trace on 1.6 mm FR-4 over a ground plane. Blue electric field lines run from the trace to the ground plane, most of them through the dielectric, some fringing through the air. Red dashed magnetic field lines circle the trace. Power flows along the trace, concentrated in the dielectric under it.
svg.text: The fields around a microstrip carry the signal (cross-section, 3 mm trace on 1.6 mm FR-4)
power flow S = E × H (out of the page)
Field lines computed from a 2-D electrostatic solve of this cross-section (E with εr = 4.4; H lines are the equipotentials of the same geometry in air).
